· Swing resistance ($267.56) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + Confirmed continuation of uptrend.

· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + 1x target position filled, leverage review contingent on signal strengthening.
